name: Escape Getting Crushed For Brainrots
desc:
Welcome to Escape Getting Crushed For Brainrots

Don't get crushed while collecting as many Brainrots as you can. Stay alert, move fast, and build your way to success!

How to play:
🏃 Run, dodge, and avoid getting crushed
🧠 Collect Brainrots to earn money
💵 Upgrade your Brainrots to increase earnings
🏗️ Improve your base to unlock more storage slots
💤 Earn cash even while offline

👍 Support the game by liking and favoriting — and join the group for bonus rewards!
